summary: Implemented every stub in src/cachetools/func.py (fifo_cache, lfu_cache, lru_cache, mru_cache, rr_cache, ttl_cache) via a shared _decorator helper that wraps cached(..., info=True) with an RLock, supports bare-decorator usage and maxsize=None through an unbounded cache (_UnboundCache, plus a maxsize-None override on _UnboundTTLCache), and emits the DeprecationWarning from mru_cache. The last full-suite run showed 215 passed and 0 failed (exit 0); tests/test_func.py alone passed 42 of 42.
